aciklama: UNITED KINGDOM — NEW TOOLS THAT ARE SWITCHED ON WITHOUT A CLINICIAN'S SIGN-OFF. By the owner's order of 2026-10-10 ("Bring on all the tools built for the new 6 countries now. We will test as we go.") every tool this country built for itself ships switched on. This is the list a clinician of the United Kingdom works through: for each tool, open the source named here, check the tool against it, and sign. A tool leaves the list when `klinisyen` names who signed it and when. A test (countries/gb/gb-araclar.test.ts) holds this list to the pack exactly: every tool of the country's own that is switched on is listed here, and nothing else is. The shared tools of the kit are not on this list; the dose calculator, switched back on the same day by the same order, is named under "ayrica".
